focus: CM-07 canonical package/module identity under live parallel-worker overlap
observed: The current workspace identifies canonical modules/stdlib packaging plus broader executable semantics as the pre-Linux frontier.
The canonical ClayCode parser accepts both `use x` and `use x.*`, while the current compatibility Module.uses projection stores only the target qid and therefore erases import mode.

During this GO cycle parallel product work appeared on the same CM-07 frontier: merged PR 636 (ClayEnv relocation regression), draft PR 635 (metadata preservation of MODULE versus WILDCARD use mode), and open PR 639 (Clay.toml package/module binding graph plus stdlib seed).

A local candidate PR 638 independently implemented a deterministic ClayPackageManifest/v1 -> ClayPackageIndex/v1 and exact-head gate, but became architecturally redundant once the broader PR 639 appeared.

bounded_unusual_experiment.name: ABSOLUTE_PACKAGE_ROOT_RELOCATION_INVARIANCE
bounded_unusual_experiment.treatment: Place identical package content under unrelated absolute host directory roots and require byte-identical canonical package index and package hash.
bounded_unusual_experiment.interpretation: The candidate package identity/index need not depend on absolute host placement.
bounded_unusual_experiment.rollback: PR 638 was closed without merge after overlap detection; no canonical product path was changed by this candidate.

overlap_collapse.reason: Avoid two competing package architectures after PR 639 appeared and PR 636 merged overlapping relocation evidence.

pr_639_review_findings.finding_1: The inspected green compatibility job tested the PR merge ref rather than head ef7d3b3, and its executed step list did not include the newly-added package-resolver gate; do not treat that run as exact-head resolver evidence.
pr_639_review_findings.finding_2: PR 639 correctly limits itself to binding/provider identity because the canonical AST still erases MODULE versus WILDCARD use mode; symbol/linker semantics must not be inferred from that lossy projection.
pr_639_review_findings.finding_3: PackageGraph.receipt serializes absolute manifest/source paths, so receipt_sha256 is host-location dependent. This can be provenance metadata but must not silently become portable package identity.

grf_collapse.generated_reality: A fresh standalone package-index implementation should be promoted because it is exact-head green and relocation invariant.
grf_collapse.counter_reality: Parallel workers may already have produced a broader package candidate; promoting both creates competing package truths.
grf_collapse.surviving_architecture: Converge on one explicit package/provider graph, preserve import mode losslessly before linker semantics, keep portable logical identity separate from host-location provenance, and require exact-head evidence before promotion.
